evals.prompt: users keep getting logged out randomly and support tickets are piling up
evals.persona: You are Sam, tech lead at a 20-person startup. Since last week's deploy, ~5% of users drop sessions at random. You suspect the session store but are not sure. Stakes: paying customers are affected. You will hand implementation to the AI but keep diagnosis decisions.
evals.expected_output: A 4d worksheet at the workspace root plus a short handoff message

evals.prompt: i have to submit a talk proposal about accessibility in civic tech next week and i have no idea what angle to take
evals.persona: You are Nadia, a frontend engineer applying to a civic-tech conference. You have not chosen an angle (testing? procurement? government services?). Deadline next Friday. Stakes: personal reputation. You want the AI to draft; you pick the angle and review.
evals.expected_output: A 4d worksheet at the workspace root plus a short handoff message

evals.prompt: my board wants a company AI policy and i have to present something in two weeks
evals.persona: You are Marcus, COO of a 200-person logistics company. The board expects an AI usage policy in two weeks. You care about liability and employee trust. Stakes: board-visible. The AI drafts; you and legal decide.
evals.expected_output: A 4d worksheet at the workspace root plus a short handoff message

assertions: Worksheet created at the session workspace root as 4d-<slug>.md — not in the skill folder or home directory
All seven body sections present: The objective, Assumptions, Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence, Your opening prompt
Every † marker in the body resolves to a line under Assumptions
No more than 5 question rounds occurred, and Round 4 ran with single-select questions
No offered option anywhere means 'these are all fine' or 'I didn't read this'
Every option states a recognizable consequence or commitment, not a bare label
The progress marker line was emitted at the end of every dialogue turn
The handoff message is short and does not restate the document
